comment: All four bipolar CV jacks are inverted: TapoCore.cc:265 divides by minus ten and adds a half, so a rising voltage lowers the setting. The audio scaling is unusual for this plugin: the input is taken as full scale at 22V and the outputs at 17V (TapoCore.cc:441-442). The edit switch is printed ADD, OFF and INS and the code maps those to the firmware's EDIT_NORMAL, EDIT_OFF and EDIT_OVERDUB (TapoCore.cc:332-343 with parameters.hh:48-52); in overdub the tap counter wraps inside the existing pattern length, in normal it runs on (multitap_delay.cc:222-227). The panel's multi-button settings gestures are switched off in this build (ui.hh:191), the same settings being on the right-click menu instead.
